cues: Somewhere in between is the biggest possible box.
At the top of the curve the slope is zero.
Derivatives find it exactly: cut three centimetres, and the box holds four hundred and thirty two cubic centimetres.
This unit is about using derivatives: for slopes, rates, approximations and the best possible answer.
